description: Correct an existing FOOD log: title, nutrition numbers, the ingredient list, meal, or time-of-day. Read get_today/get_day first — each item in `recent` (type "food") carries the `id` to pass here. Send ONLY the fields to change; values are absolute for the item as logged. Two modes, never mixed: send `ingredients` to REPLACE the whole list (include every ingredient you want kept — the log's totals recompute from it, so don't also send calories/macros), OR send top-level numbers to set totals directly — the existing ingredient breakdown then RESCALES proportionally so the parts always sum to the new totals (ingredient names/amounts don't change, so when the COMPOSITION changed — something added or removed — send `ingredients` instead). Note: ANY edit that changes a routine-created log's title or its calories — including an ingredients replacement, since totals recompute — also updates that saved routine. When logged_time changes, the log's meal may re-infer from the new hour unless you set meal explicitly. Requires a full-access token; edit one log at a time.

ingredients.description: REPLACES the full ingredient list; totals recompute from it. Cannot be combined with top-level numeric fields.

logged_time.description: HH:MM 24h — time-of-day only; the log's DATE never changes.

name: update_log
